authenticated_onchain_recovery: BLOCKED: no authenticated proof verifier or approved recovery-attestation boundary; no mutation added
revision_note: HEAD advanced externally capturing prior C reports; no commit/push commands issued; no source reversion.

prerequisite_review.independence: Separate adversarial pass by same assistant, not third-party certification

trust_boundary: TRUSTED_RPC_OBSERVATION_NOT_ON_CHAIN_PROOF; two configured sources, no authenticated chain fact or monetary mutation
verification: committed matching token event plus expected atomic unit result
discovery_limitations: Actual ABI has no global payout-count/list method; scan explicit bounded ID ranges from indexed/submitted IDs
Transaction locator is required and independently verified; no fabricated hash from memo
No automatic native event/locator or dashboard integration
implemented_recovery: Read-only identification, receipt classification, discrepancy/uncertainty/conflict evidence, durable lease-safe restart; original locks and accounting unchanged

tests.callback_observer_overlap: PASS, actual synthetic transfer and only C accounting mutation

test_distinctions: Actual local WASM/action/data receipts and live read-only RPC used
Two live RPC aliases share ONE synthetic node; not independent real operators
Forged/conflicting RPC cases use mutated copies of actual captured data
Real PostgreSQL concurrency/rollback/immutability and killed/restarted child processes; repository-only decisions explicitly synthetic
Convenience wrapper syntax checked; constituent steps executed, not another redundant end-to-end wrapper run
remaining_risks: Authenticated on-chain recovery absent; delivered/unbooked funds remain locked
RPC trust/operational independence and token/root governance not eliminated
Live recipient and actual Tidepool conformance/gas remain unverified
Production native locator indexing, mode-aware integration and dashboard remain future gates; existing restricted mode preserved
HTTP cap checked after body read; no streaming-hardening/public ingestion claim
Failed collection retains an unavailable observation, not a journal of every partial RPC response
PostgreSQL privileged owner can bypass triggers; database is never settlement authority
next_gate: Separate independent M5-D security review; no deployment decision. On-chain recovery requires a separately justified/authenticated design before mutation implementation.
